Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to Maya about Your New House
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your foreign friend, Maya, who is currently living in the same city. Read part of her email below:

"Congratulations on moving into your new home! I heard you just finished settling in. Could you tell me more about it? What do you like most about your new house and where is it located? Could you give me basic directions on how to get there from the city center? Also, I noticed you have an empty front yard—what are you planning to do with that space? I hope we can meet up soon!"

Write an email responding to Maya.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Love Marriages versus Arranged Marriages
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In many cultures such as in India, arranged marriages have long been a prevailing tradition, while in contemporary societies love marriages are increasingly favored. Some people believe that arranged marriages offer greater stability and family harmony, whereas others argue that love marriages ensure personal happiness and mutual emotional understanding."

Discuss both love marriages and arranged marriages, assess which one is better, and give your own personal opinion. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your view. You should write an essay of at least 250 words to an educated reader.
